Wola — Warsaw, Poland

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The old industrial west, rebuilt in the last decade into Warsaw's business district — glass towers, the Warsaw Uprising Museum, and a lot of new hotels. Third by recorded crime count at 1,836 in the year to June 2024, which on a district this size and this busy is unremarkable. The usual Warsaw caution about thefts from cars applies.

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Warsaw publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Wola safe?

Wandroz currently rates Wola in Warsaw as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Warsaw during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Warsaw at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Warsaw publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Wola safe at night?

At night, Wola is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Warsaw. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Wola a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Wola's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Warsaw) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Wola?

Not an official government crime feed — Wola's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know Wola well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
